title: Hotspots, endemism and the BD Act
quote: Hotspot = 1,500 endemic plants + 70% habitat lost; 2.5% of land holds 50% of plants

boxes.title: Hotspot basics
items: Criteria: **1,500** endemic vascular plants + lost **70%** habitat
Total ==**36**== (⚠ other notes: 35); once **15.7%** of land, now about **2.5%**
Hold about **50%** of vascular plants and **42%** of vertebrates as endemics
**Hottest hotspots**: **8**, incl. Western Ghats-Sri Lanka; not only tropical

boxes.title: Western Ghats
items: About **1,600 km**, **6** states; "water tower of peninsular India"
UNESCO WHS ==**2012**==: **39** component areas in **7** clusters

levels.name: NBA, Chennai (2003)
levels.note: Foreign/commercial access, IPR; civil court powers

boxes.title: Act, BHS & ABS
items: **2023** amendment (in force **1 April 2024**): offences decriminalised; AYUSH exempt
ABS raised over **₹266 crore**; **Red Sanders 45%**; excludes human genetic material

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: **Thar** not a hotspot (APPSC 2024); "two hotspots" is the old answer (2018)
Eastern Ghats rich in endemics but **not** a global hotspot
